children: Nvidia (NVDA) is set to acquire Hugging Face for about $12.9 billion, with CEO Jensen Huang confirming the deal as the chipmaker expands further into AI software and open-source development.
Nvidia stock rose 1% on Thursday's opening.

Huang said Hugging Face will remain an open platform following the transaction. The move gives Nvidia access to a widely used community for AI models, datasets and development tools while broadening its business beyond processors.
Hugging Face CEO Clement Delangue said his company approached Huang during the summer. Discussions moved quickly, leading to the agreement announced Thursday.

The purchase ranks among Nvidia's largest acquisitions, behind its $20 billion deal for Groq assets. Nvidia said the combination should provide more resources for Hugging Face while extending access to AI tools for developers and institutions.
Nvidia shares edged higher after the news.

What it means for the stock: The deal could deepen Nvidia's position across the AI stack, though investors will likely watch whether the acquisition generates meaningful returns beyond its chip business.

title: Nvidia Stock Rises After Jensen Huang Confirms $12.9 Billion Hugging Face Deal
